accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.context: Student accounts, binding state, and caseload assignment.
accounts.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, email, or student ID

panel.bindingPending: The student ID binding has not completed yet. Retry the check.
panel.bindingFailed: The student information system has no record for this account's derived ID. Correct the student ID or retry the check.

addDialog.title: Add student
addDialog.description: Create the account from the student's SIS ID, then hand over the credentials.
addDialog.studentIdHelper: 1 to 20 digits, as registered in the SIS.
addDialog.name: Display name
addDialog.passwordHelper: At least 8 characters. Share it through a safe channel.
addDialog.created: Student account created. Share the temporary password with {{name}} through a safe channel.

errors.sisUnknown: The student information system has no student with this ID. Check the ID and try again.
errors.sisUnavailable: The student information system is unavailable. Try again in a moment.

editDialog.title: Edit account
editDialog.description: Update the display name and language preference. The SIS record stays read-only.
editDialog.name: Display name
editDialog.sisHelper: These fields come from the student information system and cannot be edited here.

confirms.suspendBody: Suspension blocks login immediately and signs the student out. The account and its data stay.
confirms.correctBody: This sets the student ID for this account. The ID cannot be edited again.
confirms.deleteBody: This deletes the student account and removes the student from their advisor's caseload. This cannot be undone.

empty.title: No students match this search.
empty.body: Clear it or try another name or ID.
empty.noRowsBody: Add the first student account with their SIS ID.

assignDialog.title: Assign advisor
assignDialog.description: Type the student's SIS ID and pick the advisor. Students without an account are scheduled instead.
assignDialog.studentIdHelper: 1 to 20 digits, as registered in the SIS.
assignDialog.scheduledToast: Assignment scheduled. It applies when the student registers.
assignDialog.unchangedToast: This student already carries the selected advisor.
assignDialog.advisorsEmpty: No advisor accounts yet. Create advisor staff accounts first.

pending.title: Scheduled assignments
pending.helper: These apply automatically when the student registers.

empty.title: No scheduled assignments.
empty.body: Assignments for students without an account appear here.

cancelDialog.title: Cancel this scheduled assignment?
cancelDialog.body: This removes the scheduled assignment for student {{studentId}}. Nothing applies when the student registers. This cannot be undone.

importDialog.title: Import assignments
importDialog.helper: CSV with student_id and advisor_email columns. One row per student.
importDialog.confirmBody: Applied rows move students to the named advisors immediately. Rows that already carry the advisor stay unchanged.

errors.fileRequired: Choose a CSV or TXT file first.

importReport.title: Nothing was applied. Fix the rows and import again.

empty.title: No students match this search.
empty.body: Clear it or try another name or ID.
empty.noRowsBody: Import a CSV to assign students to advisors.

rules.title: University Rules
rules.context: Texts the AI advisor quotes when it explains rules.

delete.dialogBody: This deletes the rule. The AI advisor stops quoting it immediately. This cannot be undone.

empty.title: No university rules yet.
empty.body: Add the first rule the AI advisor quotes.

staff.title: Staff
staff.context: Every advisor, dean, vice president, and administrator in one directory.

create.title: Add staff
create.description: Create a staff account and share the initial password.
create.name: Name
create.created: Staff account created. Share the initial password with {{name}} through a safe channel.
create.resetConfirmBody: This emails a password reset link to {{email}}.

editDialog.title: Edit staff account
editDialog.description: Update the name, faculty, and role.
editDialog.name: Name

deleteDialog.title: Delete {{name}}?
deleteDialog.body: This deletes the staff account and unassigns their students. This cannot be undone.

empty.filteredTitle: No staff carry this role yet.
empty.filteredBody: Add a staff account or pick another role.

settings.title: Settings
settings.context: The queue-aging threshold for advisor queues.

threshold.title: Queue aging
threshold.context: How many days a plan waits before it counts as aging.
threshold.effect: Advisor queue rows and caseload rows flag aging past this threshold. Dean and VP aging metrics use the same value.
